name: Insulation
description: Wall batts by height (R-13, R-21), blown-in attic R-49 with baffles and rulers, rigid foam board, closed-cell spray foam by board feet, polyethylene vapor retarder and sound batts. R-values follow your climate zone. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: International Residential Code, Section N1102 Building Thermal Envelope (insulation R-values by climate zone)
The product data sheet of the coating, adhesive or product you specify (spread rate, coverage, coats)
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)
International Residential Code, Section R806 Roof Ventilation

assume: R-value by climate zone: IRC Table N1102.1.2 (IECC R402.1.2); choose the product that meets it.
Loose-fill cellulose at about R-3.7 per inch: R-49 is about 13.25 in settled (use the bag chart’s thickness for your product).
Bags: about 1 per 40 SF at R-49 (a starting figure: read the bag chart for "bags per 1,000 SF").
Attic rulers: one per 300 SF.
Baffles at each rafter bay along the eaves are counted as their own run.
items.note: Measure the attic floor area.
